Subject: Request: Vendor master record creation — Evergreen Supplies

Hi Priya —

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. We need to get Evergreen set up in our vendor master so Finance can route POs and process invoices. I attached our standard vendor onboarding form to this email. Can you please complete and return the following items so we can open a payee record?

Required items (short checklist):
- Completed vendor onboarding form (attached)
- Legal business name as registered (for tax matching)
- W-9 (or W-8 if non-US)
- Remittance address (where to send paper checks, if applicable)
- PO routing contact (name, email, phone) and preferred invoice delivery method (email/EDI)
- Bank details for ACH (bank name, account last 4, routing number) — Finance prefers secure submission (see note)

Optional but helpful:
- DUNS or LEI (if you have one)
- Primary technical/contact for integration or EDI setup

Next steps from our side once we have the docs:
- Finance will validate tax name and W-9, then create payee record and assign vendor ID
- Procurement ops will send a PO routing confirmation and sample PO
- I will follow up for any missing items and confirm target date to be PO-able

Attachment: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (PDF)

If you prefer, you can upload documents to the secure DocuSign upload link I can share after we confirm. Target timeline: return docs by EOD Wed 9/16 to hit the next billing/PO cycle.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Senior Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Priya —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the W-9. A few follow-ups from Finance and Procurement Ops:

1) Bank/ACH submission: Finance requires the full bank details via a secure channel. Please use this DocuSign secure upload to submit the ACH file: https://docusign.com/envelope/ABCDEFG12345. If your payments team prefers email, please send the file from payments@evergreen.io and copy laura_bennett@redwood.com.

2) Legal name verification: our tax team will validate the W-9 name against the completed onboarding form. If the legal entity name differs from your DBA, please note that explicitly in your reply.

3) PO/contact mapping: we will set James O'Neil as the PO routing contact. One ask — can you confirm whether invoices should be sent to james.oneil@evergreen.io or to accounting@evergreen.io? We support both.

4) Target timeline: if we get the bank info by EOD tomorrow (Fri 9/17), Finance can likely create a vendor ID by Tue 9/21 and you should be PO-able on that next cycle.

Mutual action plan (concise):
- Evergreen: return secure ACH details and confirm invoice endpoint — target 9/17
- Redwood: Finance validates W-9 and legal name, create payee record — target 9/21
- Redwood: Procurement ops to send sample PO and confirm payment terms after payee creation

Hi Priya —

This is Laura from Procurement Operations / Finance. I reviewed the W-9 and the onboarding form Marcus shared. A few items we need to finalize before we can assign a vendor ID and route POs:

- Confirm the legal business name exactly as it should appear on our payee record (must match W-9). If you operate under a different DBA, list both.
- Provide DUNS or LEI if available (helps for faster validation).
- Confirm final remittance address for invoices (you provided an address — please reconfirm).
- Upload ACH/bank details securely via the DocuSign link Marcus shared OR send from payments@evergreen.io and cc finance (laura_bennett@redwood.com). Do NOT send raw bank details from a personal email.

Once we receive the secure bank file and have the legal name match, we will:
- Create a payee record and assign Redwood Vendor ID (we will reply with the assigned ID)
- Confirm PO routing settings and payment terms (Net 30 unless you provide alternate terms in writing)
- Send a short payee setup checklist for your records

Attachment: payee_setup_checklist.pdf (PDF)

If you can get the secure ACH file to us today or tomorrow we will prioritize this to hit the 9/21 vendor creation target Marcus mentioned.

Best regards,
